6,611 likes, 57 comments - passionpassport on April 12, 2022: "9 of the Best Road Trip Routes in the World 🗺 

Near or far, long or short, road trips are often the most satisfying of journeys. By physically driving the distance between places you get to know the landscapes of the world more intimately than if you had taken a plane. From Banff to Australia & everywhere in between- if you’re itching to get behind the wheel, check out these nine incredible road-trip locations around the world. Link in bio!

📸@jolelewis @imlukemackenzie @alicethieu @kymellis 

#passionpassport #roadtrip #travel".
